signatureEngine.name: 德玛拉电池Ⅱ型
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 电光石火
refinements.description: 电属性伤害提升15%；[闪避反击]或[支援攻击]命中敌人时，装备者的能量获得效率提升18%，持续8秒。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Electric DMG by 15%. When the equipper hits an enemy with a Dodge Counter or Assist Attack, their Energy Generation Rate increases by 18% for 8s.

refinements.name: 电光石火
refinements.description: 电属性伤害提升17.5%；[闪避反击]或[支援攻击]命中敌人时，装备者的能量获得效率提升20.5%，持续8秒。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Electric DMG by 17.5%. When the equipper hits an enemy with a Dodge Counter or Assist Attack, their Energy Generation Rate increases by 20.5% for 8s.

refinements.name: 电光石火
refinements.description: 电属性伤害提升20%；[闪避反击]或[支援攻击]命中敌人时，装备者的能量获得效率提升23%，持续8秒。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Electric DMG by 20%. When the equipper hits an enemy with a Dodge Counter or Assist Attack, their Energy Generation Rate increases by 23% for 8s.

refinements.name: 电光石火
refinements.description: 电属性伤害提升22%；[闪避反击]或[支援攻击]命中敌人时，装备者的能量获得效率提升25%，持续8秒。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Electric DMG by 22%. When the equipper hits an enemy with a Dodge Counter or Assist Attack, their Energy Generation Rate increases by 25% for 8s.

refinements.name: 电光石火
refinements.description: 电属性伤害提升24%；[闪避反击]或[支援攻击]命中敌人时，装备者的能量获得效率提升27.5%，持续8秒。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Electric DMG by 24%. When the equipper hits an enemy with a Dodge Counter or Assist Attack, their Energy Generation Rate increases by 27.5% for 8s.

basic.name: 普通攻击：伏特速攻
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的斩击，前三段造成物理伤害，第四段造成电属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes. The first 3 hits deal Physical DMG, the 4th hit deals Electric DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：电光挥击
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行上挑斩击，造成电属性伤害；
若衔接在[普通攻击]第三段或[普通攻击：落雷]之后，则能够以更快的速度发动；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes an upward slash that deals Electric DMG.
This attack launches faster when used after the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack or Basic Attack: Thunderbolt.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：苍雷斩
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力上挑斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
若衔接在[普通攻击]第三段或[普通攻击：落雷]之后，则能够以更快的速度发动；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash that deals massive Electric DMG.
This attack launches faster when used after the 3rd hit of her Basic Attack or Basic Attack: Thunderbolt.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：迅雷
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：电磁引擎
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力上挑斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upwards slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：过载引擎
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力上挑斩击，并追加下落攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash at enemies in a small area followed by several downward strikes, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：降雷
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：电光一闪
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：回旋闪电
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动回旋斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 安比在[普通攻击]第三段后发动[普通攻击：落雷]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，招式造成的失衡值提升64%。
facts.textEn: Launch a Basic Attack: Thunderbolt, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack after the 3rd hit of Anby's Basic Attack for an extra 64% Daze.

cinema.name: 快充模式
cinema.description: [普通攻击]第四段斩击命中敌人时，安比的能量获得效率提升12%，持续30秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When the 4th hit of Anby's Basic Attack hits an enemy, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 12% for 30s.

cinema.name: 精准放电
cinema.description: [普通攻击：落雷]命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，招式造成的伤害提升30%；[强化特殊技]命中未处于失衡状态下的敌人时，招式造成的失衡值提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Basic Attack: Thunderbolt hits a Stunned enemy, its DMG is increased by 30%. When Anby's EX Special Attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, the Daze inflicted is increased by 10%.

cinema.name: 训练有素
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 电荷传导
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，为后场电属性角色回复3点能量；安比每拥有12%能量获得效率，回复量额外提升2点，最多额外提升6点。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Anby launches a Chain Attack or uses her Ultimate, off-field Electric Agents recover 3 Energy.
For every 12% Energy Generation Rate Anby has, recover an additional 2 Energy, up to a maximum of 6.

cinema.name: 街头经验
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 充能电场
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]时，安比获得8层充能（上限8层）；[普通攻击]或[冲刺攻击]命中敌人时，消耗1层充能，使当前招式造成的伤害提升45%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Anby uses her EX Special Attack, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When she hits an enemy with her Basic Attack or Dash Attack, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing that attack's DMG by 45%.
